sources.note: Describes SIDA (Sila [slt]), not Phana'. Pana appears only as a related neighbouring language; p.3: 'Our own preliminary investigations of the closely related languages Paza, Pana and Muji further suggest that voicing is not phonemic for the Bi-Ka languages spoken in Laos.' No statement on Pana stress (Sida itself: syllable-tone language, 'The tone bearing unit in Sida is the syllable, not the word'; no stress section).
